categories.name: Keep
categories.hint: Clean, styled interior room shot — deliberate composition (parallel verticals, corrected perspective), balanced natural or motivated lighting, uncluttered surfaces, sharp on the primary architectural feature. OVR_Quality_Score >= 60 AND REL_Quality_Score >= 60

categories.name: RealEstate
categories.hint: Correctly-shot but plain listing / real-estate photo (fisheye look, flash bounce, no styling). Useful for a real-estate-style dataset but a different bucket from editorial interiors

categories.name: Borderline
categories.hint: Interior scene but skewed verticals, blown windows, cluttered surfaces, mixed colour temperature, or only-average quality -> human review

categories.name: Exterior
categories.hint: Building exterior, streetscape or garden shot — NOT an interior room -> off-theme for an interiors dataset

categories.name: OffTopic
categories.hint: Unrelated to interior design regardless of quality (REL_Quality_Score < 30)

preset.category_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES (no exceptions):
- Fill `description` and `primary_subject` FIRST, from the pixels only. Then make every label agree with that description.
- art_medium = `photograph` ONLY for a camera-captured (or AI photoreal) image; an architectural rendering / 3D vis is `3d_render`, never `photograph`.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (melted furniture geometry, warped window frames, impossible reflections, floating objects, wrong perspective on a straight edge).
- A COMPOSITE/GRID is 2+ separate images stitched together (before/after grid, room-by-room panel) -> is_composite_grid=true and DISCARD.
- contains_text_overlay = TRUE for burned-in room labels, MLS logos, dimensions or price stamps.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
Interiors dataset. Reward corrected verticals, coherent perspective, motivated lighting, uncluttered styling and a clear architectural focal point (a fireplace, a window bay, a run of cabinetry). A plain real-estate flash-bounce shot goes to RealEstate. A building exterior or streetscape is Exterior (off-theme). Penalise heavy converging verticals, blown windows, distracting clutter, and any burned-in listing text (contains_text_overlay=true -> Borderline at best; DISCARD if the overlay dominates). The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score.

scoring.notes: Reward corrected verticals, balanced window/interior exposure, styled but uncluttered surfaces and coherent colour temperature. Penalise skewed perspective, blown highlights on windows, mixed colour casts and heavy clutter.
